inputs.text: This was never just about whether the accusation could hold up. The alleged contact with Karachi-based “Punjabi Kuri” was wrapped in national-security secrecy, letting suspicion stand in for evidence while the public was kept anxious. The Punjab and Haryana High Court’s warning that suspicion alone cannot justify indefinite detention forced them to retreat, but bail is no proof the accusation was false—or true. The pressure campaign may have served its purpose already: fear first, accountability later, and no clear answer about who benefits.
